summary: Targeted re-test of reversed typing bug in RichText editors (ClassDetail and Assignments). All scenarios pass: typing per-character preserves correct LTR order, newline/multiline order preserved, Bold formatting applies without crash, end-to-end save of assignment with description works and description is preserved as typed.

issues: Guru dropdown shows duplicate 'TEST guru' entries — likely a duplicate seed/list, worth deduping or showing unique display name

critical_code_review_comments: RichText fix is correct: mount-only useEffect sets innerHTML once; contentEditable has no dangerouslySetInnerHTML. onInput propagates HTML upward keeping caret stable.
Minor: Guru list contains duplicates ('TEST guru' x2) — consider distinct-by-id and/or unique display names in the dropdown render.
seed_data_creation: Created one assignment titled 'TEST_ReverseTypingBug' in class XI IPA 2 (b9e38fdb-a9f2-4dcf-b5f0-db049fcc1405) with description 'bosek pagi ini\nselamat datang' (bolded).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reversed-typing bug in RichText editors is fixed and verified. ClassDetail editor (data-testid assignment-desc-editor) and Assignments editor (data-testid assign-desc-editor) both type in correct order and persist on save. Observed cosmetic issue: duplicate guru entries in the Guru dropdown.
rca of the issue: Previous implementation used dangerouslySetInnerHTML tied to React state on every render; each keystroke reset the DOM and moved the caret to position 0 so subsequent characters were inserted before the previous ones (producing reversed text). Fix: initialize innerHTML once in a mount-only useEffect and keep the editor uncontrolled, propagating changes via onInput. Verified by typing per-character using page.keyboard.type and reading inner_text.
